svg.title: Vetrix Client / Pet Owner data flow diagram
svg.desc: 4.1 Register and manage account; 4.2 Register pets and request edits; 4.3 Request or cancel appointments; 4.4 Browse products and place orders; 4.5 View care records and submit feedback. Labeled arrows show data exchanged with logical stores.
svg.text: Data flow diagram • Simplified Level 1 role view
Pet profiles, QR tokens and review
Record request, read status or visit
Rectangle = user • Rounded box = process • Divided box = data store • Arrow = direction of data
Repeated users and store IDs refer to the same entity or store. Rows show data flows, not a sequence of steps.
Client interactions use the mobile API. Authentication and routine logging are omitted.
